shots.beat: Noor's trembling hand reaches toward the glowing flower in the dark greenhouse as Elias lunges into frame.

line.speaker: c1
line.text: Don't touch it. It's the last living thing from Earth.

shots.beat: Noor freezes, pulls her hand back, and stares at the old man, shaken and defensive.

line.speaker: c2
line.text: Then why does it feel like it's calling me?

shots.beat: Elias slowly steps back, his face shifting from anger to dread, as the flower's glow pulses.
The flower slowly turns its bloom away from Elias and toward Noor, its light brightening on her stunned face.
